route.monitoring.title: Monitoring
route.monitoring.description: Inspect one metric at a time, or open your saved dashboard.
route.insights.title: Insights
route.insights.description: Explore environments, loaded consumers and recent events for the selected source.
route.assistant.title: Smart Assistant
route.assistant.description: Choose a source and resource, then investigate with evidence and an explicit question.
route.help.title: Help
route.help.description: Find a short guide for the task in front of you.
assistant.workspace.guest: Smart Assistant is unavailable in the guest demonstration. Use an authenticated installation with an operator-enabled profile; no question is sent from this page.
assistant.workspace.scope: Only this resource is in scope. Reading a page does not send a question. Changing resource or leaving the page clears the current conversation view.
assistant.workspace.refine: Refine the resource search to continue beyond these ten pages.
help.start.title: Getting started
help.start.intro: The overview is a short health summary. Each task has its own page.
help.start.one: Choose an infrastructure source. Its availability and health describe the observations currently available.
help.start.two: Use Resources to find a workload, Topology for relationships, and Events or Logs for the corresponding evidence.
help.start.three: Open Monitoring for metric trends, Insights for environment and consumer details, or Smart Assistant for a resource investigation.
help.monitoring.title: Metrics and dashboards
help.monitoring.intro: Monitoring starts with one metric so charts stay readable.
help.monitoring.one: Choose CPU, memory, restarts, received bytes or sent bytes. The URL retains the selected metric and time range.
help.monitoring.two: Open My dashboard to show, hide, reorder or widen the five fixed panels. Reset restores the default layout.
help.monitoring.three: Layouts stay in this browser for the current account. Partial or stale data is marked; a chart is not proof of a fleet-wide total.
help.assistant.title: Smart Assistant
help.assistant.intro: The assistant works with one selected resource and bounded, authorized evidence. An operator must enable its profile.
help.assistant.one: Choose a source and resource on the Smart Assistant page. Use the resource name search and page controls when needed.
help.assistant.two: Choose a time window and ask a question, or select the incident investigation goal. Log reads need explicit consent; an unavailable profile shows an unavailable state.
help.assistant.three: Open the report or a cited reference to inspect evidence. Answers are qualified, may have gaps, and do not execute infrastructure changes. Changing resource or leaving clears the view.
help.security.title: Access and privacy
help.security.intro: The server enforces access for every protected request.
help.security.one: Use your own account. Administrators manage users and deployment settings; viewers retain their read permissions.
help.security.two: Change your password from the account menu. Language and display settings live under Settings → Preferences.
help.security.three: Never paste credentials or private configuration into a question or support report. Availability, freshness and permission errors are different states.
help.support.title: Need more help?
help.support.description: Report a reproducible problem with the version, page and expected result. Remove passwords, tokens, private names, logs and configuration before sharing. The issue tracker is public and opens in a new tab.
